svg.aria-label: A rotary index table with a fixed centre tower. A pusher feeds the next task tile from the backlog chute onto the table, where a stamp marks it in progress. The table turns a quarter at a time: a reading head lights the spec it reads, a spindle works the tile, and four probes test it while a stack light shows build, lint, tests and acceptance. When the tests fail the table turns back to the spindle; only when all four lamps are lit does a ram push the tile into the done shuttle, where a labeller adds its summary. After the last task the full suite runs again and a beacon lights.
